definitions.population: All 1008 noncrowd/nonignored dev250 GT; small original mask area <=1024; medium 1024<area<=9216.
definitions.geometry: Independent best same/other-class mask IoU; not one-to-one. AP top100 and one-class-per-query cache are separate views. AP row IDs are local ordinals, never decoder query IDs.
definitions.residual_cause: Exclusive hierarchy for selected .3: matched50; same-class selected geometry>=.5 but consumed by another GT; correct raw geometry>=.5 filtered by score; only wrong-class raw geometry>=.5; any raw geometry>=.1; no raw geometry>=.1.
definitions.matching: Selected .3 score/ID ordered same-class greedy one-to-one; IoU tie smallest GT ID, identical to wkq association at .5. .75 uses the same diagnostic rule, not COCO AP/AR.
definitions.shape: Pixel precision/recall and 1-original-pixel inner-boundary IoU on actual .5 matched pairs. Neither standard Boundary AP nor causal AP-loss decomposition; matched subset only.
definitions.interpretation: Score is class probability times mask quality. Cache lacks original logits, so score-filtered loss is not proof of classification alone. No saved mask is an output-level observation, not proof of backbone cause.
definitions.cases: Deterministic failure illustrations selected by category/size/low IoU; not a random quality sample.
